final_goal: Reusable, provider-neutral story visual asset system that searches/reuses/derives/composites accepted assets before generating new images.

current_gate.next: Define the controlled three-style benchmark, minimal asset schema, and measurement plan.

cost_truth.documented: No verified evidence that semantic art style alone lowers billed image-output tokens at fixed model/quality/size.
cost_truth.strategy: Reduce new generations/retries; exploit lower quality/resolution where acceptable; reuse/derive/composite first.

unknowns: Best audience-facing style among reuse-friendly candidates.
Actual provider-specific cost delta between candidate styles after controlling for size/quality.
First-pass acceptance and retry rates by style.
Minimum useful reusable asset set for one recurring IP.
Threshold at which embedding retrieval adds value beyond structured tags.
